name: Martin Heidegger
contribution: A German philosopher whose work was central to the development of phenomenology, hermeneutics, and existentialism.

checks.lead: Martin Heidegger (26 September 1889 – 26 May 1976) was a German philosopher whose work was central to the development of phenomenology, hermeneutics, and existentialism. He has had significant impact within subsequent philosophy, social sciences and humanities, and theology.
